description: Generation Mix Latest Values is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Generation Mix Latest Values dataset provides information on the breakdown of generation technologies within our Northeast licence area. The dataset provides the most recent half hourly data, with values for each generation type along with a demand and generation total. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Net Zero Future. Its keywords are Generation, Low Carbon Technologies (LCT). The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
